value.text:
Hays International College is a private tertiary training institution in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia. It offers certificate and diploma courses in Leisure and Health, Individual Support, and Early Childhood Education and Care. Its location is described as urban, in Box Hill.

From 2009 until January 2022, the college occupied 15 Hay Street in Box Hill South. That address had previously been the site of St. Leo’s Christian Brothers College, which closed in 1994. Hays International College moved to 693 Station Street, Box Hill, in February 2022. Its Latin motto is “Eruditio Nostram Viam Illuminat”, rendered in English as “Education Illuminates Our Way”.
